in_marathi.name: Ardhendu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The One Who Reaches the Summit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ardhendu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ardhendu is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ardh’ meaning summit, peak, or top, and ‘indu’ meaning drop, rain, or lord. This name signifies someone who has reached the pinnacle of success or spiritual enlightenment.

This name signifies someone who has reached the pinnacle of success or spiritual enlightenment.
